After that, they sit behind the "Configure search" button.
Em \"Chave da Apify\", cole a chave da s: In "Apify key", paste your Apify account key. On the Apify site it's under Settings and shows up as "API token". Then click "Save key". Before saving, the system checks the key with Apify: if it isn't accepted, nothing is saved and a warning appears. Once accepted, it's stored encrypted on the server, the boxes close and "Search key saved." appears. The saved key isn't shown again; to change it, paste the new one and save again.

No quadro \"1. Encontrar empresas\", esc: In the "1. Find businesses" box, type the kind of business in "Audience or segment" and where it is in "City or region", the way you'd search on Google Maps. mais de um agente no mesmo número: more than one agent on the same number
direcionar conversa para o agente certo: send conversation to the right agent
Roteadores não aparece direto no menu la: Routers doesn't appear directly in the side menu. In the "AI agent" group of the menu, click "See all in AI". In the "Set up the agent" section you'll find the "Routers" card. The full path is: AI agent › See all in AI › Routers.

Um agente de IA é o atendente virtual qu: An AI agent is the virtual assistant that answers clients on WhatsApp. When the company has more than one agent, each handling one topic, the router decides who answers. It reads the client's message, understands what the person wants (the "intent") and hands the conversation to the agent for that topic. Each router is tied to one WhatsApp number. Here you see the router Clínica Bem Viver is setting up for the front desk number.
Cada cartão é um roteador. No alto vêm o: Each card is a router. At the top are the name and the "active" or "inactive" badge. Active means it already decides who answers the number's conversations. Inactive means it decides nothing: the number stays with the agent published on it, as if the router didn't exist. Below are the WhatsApp number and how many intents it has. This one is still "inactive" and "No intents configured": the clinic will set everything up before turning it on.

Click the card to open the router. "Identification" holds the name, the number and the switch that turns it on and off. In "Intents", on the right, you say which topics it recognizes and which agent handles each one. Further down, on the left, are "Agent by sender number" (to always send certain phone numbers to one agent, before the AI decides), the AI model that reads the messages, the backup agent for when no intent fits, and a test. Nothing you change applies until you click "Save".
Um gerente também abre os roteadores, ma: A manager can also open the routers, but only to view and test: the fields are locked and the "New router", "Intent", "Save" and "Delete router" buttons don't appear. Only the administrator creates, changes and deletes routers.

este número já tem um roteador ativo: this number already has an active router

Na janela \"Novo roteador\", dê um nome: In the "New router" window, give it a name that says what it's for. In "WhatsApp number", you choose the number it will answer: the list shows the company's WhatsApp numbers, each with its status. Notice the message below: you can only have one active router per number.
Clique no número que o roteador vai aten: Click the number the router will answer. Here you see "Bem Viver Front Desk", with the status "Connected". Choose carefully: once created, the router's number can't be changed. For another number, create another router.
Com o nome e o número escolhidos, o botã: With the name and number chosen, the "Create router" button lights up. The new router starts out active. So if the chosen number already has another active router, the system refuses and warns: "This number already has an active router.". In that case, turn the other one off first. To give up, click "Cancel".
Depois de criado, a página do roteador a: After it's created, the router's page opens on its own, with the message "Router created — now choose the intents.". It already shows as "active", but it doesn't have intents or a backup agent yet. While it's like this, whoever answers the number is still the agent that was already published on it. The next step is to add the intents, in the next lesson.
Ensinar ao roteador cada assunto que os: Teach the router each topic clients bring up and say which agent handles each one.
Uma intenção é um assunto que faz o clie: An intent is a topic that makes the client write in, like "book an appointment" or "test results". The router compares each message with the registered intents and picks the one that matches best. This router doesn't have any yet. To add the first one, click "Intent", with the plus sign.
Em \"Nome da intenção\", escreva um nome: In "Intent name", type a short name, like "Book an appointment". Two topics in the same router can't have the same name. In "Agent that handles it", choose who takes over the conversation when the client wants this. In this example clinic there's only Bia. In an operation with several agents, each intent points to the agent who knows that topic.
O agente escolhido aqui não precisa de n: The agent chosen here doesn't need its own number. After you save, its screen shows the message "This agent is triggered by the router" and, without its own number, it can be published using the router's number.
Em \"Quando escolher esta intenção\", de: In "When to choose this intent", describe the situation in your own words, the way you'd explain it to a new team member. This is the text the AI reads to decide. The name, the agent and this description are required: while any of them is missing, a red warning appears below the block and the "Save" button stays grayed out.
Em \"Frases de exemplo (opcional)\", esc: In "Example phrases (optional)", type messages the way a patient would write them and press Enter, or click "Add". Each phrase becomes a tag; clicking a tag removes the phrase. You can add up to 10 phrases per intent. The examples help the AI recognize the topic even when the client words it differently.
\"Funil de destino (opcional)\" serve pa: "Destination pipeline (optional)" is for those who have a sales pipeline for each service. If you leave "No destination — just choose the agent", the router only chooses who answers. If you choose a pipeline, when this intent is recognized the system moves the client's deal to that pipeline before the agent replies. Then the "Destination stage" field also appears, already set to "First open stage".
Se quem administra o servidor ligou o re: If whoever manages the server turned on the optional "Support flows" feature, each intent also gets the "Support flow (optional)" field: a script of questions that starts when the intent is recognized.
Para outro assunto, clique de novo em \": For another topic, click "Intent" again: each one gets its own block, and the trash can next to the agent removes the block. Nem toda mensagem combina com uma intenç: Not every message matches an intent, and the AI may also be unsure: with less than 60% certainty, its choice doesn't count. For these cases there's the "Fallback agent", the backup agent: when the conversation isn't with the agent of any intent yet, it's the one that handles what wasn't recognized. Here it's Bia. If you choose "None — responds with the default support", the agent published on the number answers.
Se a IA que lê as mensagens falhar, por: If the AI that reads the messages fails, for example because the provider account is out of credit, the conversation stays with the agent of the intent that was already handling it; if it wasn't with any agent yet, it goes to the backup agent.

In this example clinic there's no usable AI key, so the field is locked and the message asks you to register one in Credentials (AI agent › See all in AI › Credentials). In "Previous messages for routing", from 0 to 16, you say how many earlier messages in the conversation the AI reads along with the current one: more messages help it understand the context, but can increase the cost and the wait.

\"Testar classificação\" mostra o que o: "Test classification" shows what the router would do with a phrase of yours, without touching any real conversation. You type the way a client would write and click the button. You see the chosen intent, the AI's certainty as a percentage and the agent that would answer. If the certainty is below the minimum, the result warns that, for real, the conversation wouldn't follow that intent. The test uses the real AI and spends the provider's credit. It only works with the router active; that's why the message "Turn on the router to test the classification." appears.
O gerente, que só pode ver a tela, també: The manager, who can only view the screen, can also use the test.
Se outro roteador já estiver ativo no me: If another router is already active on the same number, the system refuses when you save, with the message "This number already has an active router.". Turn the other one off first.
\"Excluir roteador\", no canto de cima,: "Delete router", in the top corner, erases the router and all its intents. First, a window asks for confirmation. If you just want to pause the router for a while, turn off the switch instead of deleting it.
O material da sua empresa que o agente d: Your company's material that the AI agent reads before answering: frequently asked questions, preparation instructions, policies. Here you teach, review and take material offline.
Conhecendo a tela de Conhecimento: Getting to know the Knowledge screen
Entender o que é o acervo do agente, o q: Understand what the agent's library is, what the key warning means and what each material card shows.
Conhecimento não aparece direto no menu: Knowledge doesn't appear directly in the side menu. In the "AI agent" group of the menu, click "See all in AI". In the "Teach the agent" section you'll find the "Knowledge" card. The full path is: AI agent › See all in AI › Knowledge.
Só gerente ou administrador vê este cart: Only a manager or administrator sees this card. For an agent, or for someone with read-only permission, it doesn't appear, and the screen's address leads to an access denied page.
O agente de IA é o atendente virtual que: The AI agent is the virtual assistant that answers patients on WhatsApp. This screen, "What the agent knows", stores the clinic's material that it reads before answering: frequently asked questions, exam preparation, prices. With the material, it looks up the right answer instead of improvising. The screen belongs to the whole company: each assistant chooses, on its own screen, which of these materials it can read.
Para o agente conseguir procurar no mate: For the agent to be able to search the material, the system prepares the text with the help of an artificial intelligence service: OpenAI, OpenRouter or Google. This requires a key from that service, called an "embedding key". When the key is working, instead of this warning you'll see the phrase "Ready to prepare material." and which key is in use. At this clinic the material was prepared by OpenAI, and the OpenAI key is no longer usable. That's why there's the warning with the triangle: until this is fixed, the agent can't look up the material.
Uma chave deixa de ser utilizável quando: A key stops being usable when it's deleted, deactivated or rejected when checked with the service. How to register the key is covered in the lesson "Register the key that prepares the material".
O quadro \"Estado da base de conheciment: The "Knowledge base status" panel counts the materials in the library, not including archived ones. "Ready" are the ones the agent already finds. "With error" are the ones that failed to prepare. When one is being prepared at that moment, "preparing" also appears. Material waiting for the key counts in the total, but not in "ready" or in "with error". When there's a failure, the line below, with the triangle, says where to see the reason.
Com chave valendo e tudo preparado, o qu: With a working key and everything prepared, the panel shows "all set", in green. With no material at all, the panel doesn't even appear.
À esquerda, a tela diz quantos materiais: On the left, the screen says how many materials are in the library, not counting archived ones. "Add material" opens the form to teach the agent something new. "Prepare everything again" has the system prepare all the materials again; anything that was already ready and hasn't changed is skipped. This button stays grayed out as long as there's no working key.
A lista se atualiza sozinha: quando o si: The list updates on its own: when the system finishes preparing a material, the card changes without you reloading the page.
Cada cartão é um material. No alto vêm o: Each card is a material. At the top is the name and, below it, the type, like "Questions and answers". "Prepared" says how long ago the system last prepared the material, or "never". "Snippets the agent finds" is how many pieces the text was split into for searching. "Looked up by" lists the assistants that read this material.
\"Nenhum assistente ainda\", em laranja,: "No assistant yet", in orange, means no assistant has selected this material. To connect it, open "Agents", go into the assistant, check the material in "What it checks before answering" and publish. Only the published version counts.
O selo colorido no canto do cartão diz e: The colored badge in the corner of the card says where the material stands. "The agent already knows", in green: it's prepared and the agent finds it. "Didn't enter", in red: the preparation failed, and the reason is in "Why it wasn't included". "Waiting for the key", in orange: the material was saved, but will only be prepared when there's a working key. There's also "Partially added", in orange: only part of the material was prepared. It counts toward "with error" in the panel above. Click "Prepare again" to try to complete it.
Dois selos não aparecem aqui. \"Ainda nã: Two badges don't appear here. "Not prepared yet", in gray, is for material that hasn't gone through preparation yet, like one that was just added. "Preparing…", in blue, appears while the system is preparing.
Cadastrar a chave que prepara o material: Register the key that prepares the material
Saber de onde vem a chave de embedding e: Learn where the embedding key comes from and register it without leaving the Knowledge screen.
Dentro do aviso, a linha \"Quem prepara: Inside the warning, the line "Who prepares the knowledge base" says which service prepared this clinic's material: here, OpenAI. To fix it without leaving the screen, click "Register the key here". The "AI › Credentials" link leads to the screen with all of the company's AI keys.
O material já preparado só é encontrado: Material that's already prepared can only be found with the same service that prepared it. That's why a key from another service isn't used on its own.
Em \"Provedor da chave de embedding\", e: In "Embedding key provider", choose which service the key is from: OpenAI, OpenRouter or Google. Since this knowledge base is prepared by OpenAI, the key needs to be from OpenAI or OpenRouter. The materials' text is sent to the chosen service to prepare the search. In "What you want to call this key", give it a name so you can recognize it later; if you leave it blank, it keeps the suggested name, like "OpenAI key".
Se você cadastrar uma chave do Google, e: If you register a Google key, it isn't used on its own: the "Switch to Google" button appears, and switching prepares the whole knowledge base again.
No campo \"Chave da OpenAI\", cole a cha: In the "OpenAI key" field, paste the key you created on the service's website; the address appears right below the field, like platform.openai.com/api-keys. The key is stored encrypted and never shows up on the screen again. Click "Save key". The system checks the key with the service, which takes a few seconds. Once it's accepted, the warning is replaced by "Ready to prepare material.", with the key's name.
Com a chave valendo, clique em \"Prepara: With the key working, click "Prepare everything again" to prepare the material that was left behind. "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything. Only the administrator can save the key. A manager sees the warning and the form, but when clicking "Save key" gets a message saying they don't have permission.
Cadastrar um material novo: escolher o t: Register new material: choose the type, write questions and answers in the right format and save it to the library.
Para ensinar algo novo ao agente, clique: To teach the agent something new, click "Add material", on the right, above the cards.
Que tipo de material é: What type of material it is
Primeiro escolha o tipo. \"Perguntas e r: First choose the type. "Questions and answers" is already selected: these are the questions that come up again and again, with the answer ready. It's the format the agent uses best, because each answer comes through whole. "Document" is continuous text, like a policy or a manual. "Previous conversations" and "Product catalog" are grayed out: the system fills them in on its own, and you can't type anything in them.
Com \"Documento\", você envia um arquivo: With "Document", you upload a file or paste the text. "File (optional)" takes PDF, Markdown, CSV or text, up to 20 MB. If you don't have the file, paste the text in the "…or paste the text here" field. The PDF needs to have selectable text: a PDF made only of scanned images has no letters for the system to read.
Planilha do Excel não entra direto: salv: An Excel spreadsheet can't go in directly: save it as CSV before uploading.
Agora vamos cadastrar perguntas e respos: Now let's add questions and answers. Click "Questions and answers" again. In "Material name", give it a name you'll recognize later. In "Content", write each item on two lines: one starting with "## Pergunta:" and the other with "## Resposta:". Leave a blank line between one item and the next.
As marcas \"## Pergunta:\" e \"## Respos: The markers "## Pergunta:" and "## Resposta:" are written in Portuguese, even when the screen is in another language. Without them, the system doesn't find any pair and doesn't save the material.
Antes do botão, o formulário avisa, em l: Before the button, the form warns, in orange letters, when there's no working key: the material stays saved and waiting, and the agent only gets to know it after the key is registered. Click "Add to the library". "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything.

O material novo aparece primeiro na grad: The new material appears first in the grid, with the "Not prepared yet" badge. With a working key, the system starts preparing it within moments: the badge changes to "Preparing…" and then to "The agent already knows". Without a key, as at this clinic, the badge changes to "Waiting for the key".

Ler o que está guardado num material, ve: Read what's stored in a material, see what the agent learned from it, fix the content, understand why a material didn't go in and take a material offline.
Para ver o que está guardado num materia: To see what's stored in a material, click "Read the material", at the bottom of the card. Clicking the material's name does the same.
A página mostra o material como ele foi: The page shows the material the way it was added. In a questions and answers material, each item appears with the "Question" on top and the "Answer" below. In a document, the whole text appears. To go back to the list, click "Back to the library".
\"Ver o que ele aprendeu\" mostra os tre: "See what it learned" shows the snippets the agent looks up before answering: the pieces the system split the material into. When the agent gets something wrong about a topic, this is where you see why. Next to each snippet is its size in tokens, the unit of text that AI services use. The button only appears when the material already has snippets.
\"Editar conteúdo\" abre o texto atual d: "Edit content" opens the material's current text, in the same "## Pergunta:" and "## Resposta:" format. Change whatever you need and click "Save content". What you save replaces the previous content, and the system prepares the material again.
\"Editar conteúdo\" só existe nos materi: "Edit content" only exists for questions and answers materials. A document can't be edited here: to change it, archive the old one and add the new version.
Num material com o selo \"Não entrou\",: On a material with the "Didn't enter" badge, click "Why it wasn't included" to see the reason. It comes exactly as the service replied, sometimes in English. Here, "Incorrect API key provided" means OpenAI rejected the key. After fixing the cause, for example by registering a key that works, click "Prepare again" so the system tries again.

Para tirar um material do ar, clique em: To take a material offline, click "Archive". There's no confirmation question: the click archives it right away, and no assistant looks up that material anymore. Before that, check "Looked up by": the assistants listed there stop knowing about that topic.
